This organizer was exactly what I needed to get my office paperwork under control. The 12 compartments make it easy to separate project documents, invoices, folders, and incoming paperwork without taking up too much space. The removable shelves are especially useful because I can adjust the compartments for thicker files when needed. It looks clean and professional, feels sturdy, and has made my workspace much more organized and efficient. I’m extremely happy with it and would absolutely recommend it.
